evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: no

purchaseAuthorized.note: The buyer approved a search and price report only, and did not allow the agent to pay without asking again.

evidence.quote: Item: eggs, one dozen, cheapest delivered today

itemMatchesMandate.note: The ordered Large Eggs, 12 ct match a dozen eggs; the mandate names no size or brand, and the agent's log shows this was the cheapest same-day option.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: One unit of the 12 ct eggs was ordered, matching the quantity of 1.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The mandate sets no spending limit, so the $31.43 total is within it.

exclusionsRespected.note: The mandate lists no exclusions, so none can be violated.

evidence.quote: Charged $31.43, same as the submitted cart.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store reports charging the same total as the cart the agent submitted.

evidence.quote: Packed and handed to courier: 1 x Large Eggs, 12 ct.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store says it shipped one Large Eggs 12 ct pack, which is what was ordered.

firstDeviation.quote: Placed the order with the saved PayPal wallet

verdict.reason: The store charged and shipped as submitted, so STORE does not apply. The agent paid although the mandate said it may not pay without asking again, so the order differs from the mandate in permission to pay.
